page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is a bare-metal compute-optimized instance equipped with hardware acceleration. Powered by the x86_64 architecture, the server delivers 128 dedicated vCPUs alongside 768 GB of system memory, providing a resource allocation of 6.0 GB per core. The configuration incorporates four NVIDIA A10 GPUs, providing an aggregate graphic memory footprint of 96 GB (24 GB VRAM per GPU) managed under a KVM hypervisor environment.

The instance does not include integrated local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for all persistence requirements. To facilitate rapid data transfer between external storage arrays and compute clusters, it is configured with a 64 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance allocates zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating standard virtual private cloud routing or assigned public addresses for external connectivity.

Hardware density in this configuration provides balanced multi-GPU processing capacity without requiring costly top-tier deep learning accelerators like A100 or H100 units. The absence of local solid-state drives makes processing pipelines reliant on network I/O, which is supported by the 64 Gbps link. This setup is structured for workloads such as medium-scale artificial intelligence inference, cloud gaming, video rendering, computer vision pipelines, and parallel compute tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is an accelerated bare-metal server built on x86_64 architecture for parallel processing and compute-heavy tasks. The configuration features 128 dedicated vCPUs and 768 GB of system memory, giving 6.0 GB per core. Acceleration is delivered via four NVIDIA A10 GPUs totaling 96 GB of GDDR6 VRAM. Running on the KVM hypervisor, the platform provides a high-throughput baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps to accommodate large network data transfers. There is no bundled local storage included with the instance, requiring storage to be attached over the network, and it includes no complimentary public IPv4 addresses. This combination of multi-GPU acceleration, high core count, and extensive network bandwidth makes the instance suitable for distributed artificial intelligence inference, graphic rendering workloads, video transcoding pipelines, and data-intensive analytical processing.
